name: adc_oneshot_read
description: adc/oneshot_read on the ESP32-C3: ADC1's channels 2 and 3 (GPIO2, GPIO3) at 12 dB, read once a second; 1.1 V and 2.2 V give 1.1 x 0.25 / 1.1 x 4095 = 1024 and 2048 at the TRM's ideal transfer. The eFuses hold no calibration, so the example reports the raw values only.
